narrative:
## Handover Summary — Workforce & Clinical Staffing

Workforce plan validated against the cost of care and the revenue activity plan.

## Key Decisions
• Agency staffing target 9% of clinical hours — 120 agency roles converted to permanent
• Dental nurse retention payment and flexible rostering in high-utilisation practices
• +80 clinical FTE for King Edward VII and New Victoria hospitals, phased with activity

## Recommendation for Consolidation
Stress-test the Clinics & Hospitals revenue ramp against the hiring timeline — the revenue uplift assumes theatre staffing is in place by Q2.

signals.title: King Edward VII and New Victoria hospitals join UK Health Services
signals.excerpt: UK Health Services revenue grew on higher volumes and the two acquisitions; underlying profit reduced as Bupa invests for growth.
